h1: The 8 Best Halloween Lights of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 Halloween string lights scored on run length, lighting modes, connectability, power source and weather rating, all under $25.
summary: The weillsnow 500 LED string is the best Halloween light for covering a yard: 164 feet of waterproof orange and purple on a 29V low-voltage supply. The DAZZLE BRIGHT 300 LED set chains up to three strings for a bigger display, and the Brizled adds memory and a timer. For battery-only spots, the LOLStar is the one without a plug.
intro: The cheapest Halloween lights fail at the wall plug, not at the bulb. A string that looks fine in the box turns out to have a short lead cord, a controller that forgets its mode every time you flip the switch, or no way to chain a second set, and by October 25 you are standing in the yard with a mismatched ladder of extension cords.

Primea editors reviewed eight string lights that all sit under $25 and ranked them on run length, connectability, lighting modes, power type and weather rating. Because the price bracket is identical, we sorted by features a buyer will actually miss: memory function, timers, end-to-end chaining and a stated waterproof or safety certification.

products.name: weillsnow 500 LED Halloween Lights Outdoor, 164 FT
products.verdict: 500 LEDs over 164 feet, waterproof, with 8 modes and memory.
products.description:
The weillsnow set runs 500 LEDs along 164 feet of orange and purple wire, on a 29V low-voltage supply, with 8 modes and a memory function. Low voltage keeps the wire cool to the touch, which is the safer choice around shrubs and railings.

It wins because no other set here covers as much ground at the same price. The DAZZLE BRIGHT below has 300 LEDs and chains for more, but the weillsnow's 164 feet reaches a whole porch rail or tree in one run. The waterproof rating suits outdoor use.

Buy it for a front yard or tree wrap. The caveat is wire spacing: 500 LEDs over 164 feet means a sparser glow than a short, tight string.
products.idealFor: Yards, porch rails and tree wraps that need a long run.
products.skipIf: You only need a short strand for a mantel.

products.name: DAZZLE BRIGHT Halloween 300 LED String Lights
products.verdict: 300 LEDs, 8 modes and room to connect up to three strings.
products.description:
DAZZLE BRIGHT supplies 300 LEDs with 8 light modes and lets you connect up to three strings, staying under 1,000 LEDs total. That cap is a real limit, because overloading a single plug can trip a fuse.

It ranks second because it asks you to plan your coverage. The weillsnow reaches farther in one piece, while this one lets you build up gradually and keep a small set for indoors.

A fit for a mantel, window or doorway. The caveat is the 1,000-LED ceiling, which is generous for most homes but not enough to line a large yard.
products.idealFor: Doorways, windows and mantels that may grow over the years.
products.skipIf: You want one long outdoor run with memory.

products.name: Brizled Halloween Lights Outdoor
products.verdict: End-to-end connectable with 8 modes, a memory function and a timer.
products.description:
Brizled's outdoor string is end-to-end connectable, with 8 lighting modes and both memory and timer functions. A timer means the lights switch on and off without you, which saves going out in the cold.

It lands third because the listing gives no LED count or length, so you cannot judge coverage the way you can with the weillsnow or DAZZLE BRIGHT. What it does list is the best control set of the group.

A smart buy for people who forget to unplug at night. The caveat is size: check the product page for length and count before planning a layout.
cons: LED count and length not listed
products.idealFor: People who want set-and-forget lights with a timer.
products.skipIf: You need to know length and LED count first.

products.name: 20FT 100Ct Purple Orange Halloween Lights
products.verdict: 100 incandescent bulbs on 20 feet, UL certified and end-to-end connectable.
products.description:
This string has 100 purple and orange incandescent bulbs across 20 feet, is end-to-end connectable, and is UL certified. Incandescent bulbs give a warm, classic glow that LEDs imitate imperfectly.

It ranks fourth because incandescent strings draw more power and run hotter than LED sets, so they suit short runs. The UL certification is the clearest safety statement in the lineup, and the strand is short enough to be easy to place.

Choose it for a classic Halloween glow around a door. The caveat is heat: do not bundle it against fabric or dry foliage.
products.idealFor: Doorframes and porches that want a traditional warm glow.
products.skipIf: You want effects, modes or low-heat LEDs.

products.name: TW SHINE Halloween Lights
products.verdict: Eight lighting modes with a safety and waterproof pitch.
products.description:
TW SHINE's Halloween Lights offer 8 lighting modes, a combination mode among them, and are described as safe and waterproof. Waterproofing matters for any string you leave outside through October rain.

It ranks fifth because the listing does not give LED count or length, and it has no timer or memory mention. Against Brizled, which lists both, it offers fewer controls.

An acceptable choice for a basic outdoor strand. The caveat is that without a stated length, plan on checking the product page before you rely on it to cover a specific area.
products.idealFor: Simple outdoor decorating with a choice of effects.
products.skipIf: You want timer or memory controls.

products.name: Joomer Orange Purple Halloween Lights
products.verdict: 8 modes, memory and a timer in a plain orange and purple string.
products.description:
Joomer lists 8 lighting modes, a memory function and a timer in its orange and purple string. That trio is the same control set as Brizled's, without the outdoor and end-to-end claims.

It ranks sixth because the listing is brief: no length, LED count or weather rating are stated. It pulls ahead of the TW SHINE sets by naming the timer and memory, which are the features you use daily.

A reasonable indoor pick for a mantel or window. The caveat is the lack of an outdoor claim, so keep it under cover.

products.name: LOLStar Halloween String Lights
products.verdict: Battery powered with a timer and 8 flashing modes for outlet-free spots.
products.description:
LOLStar's string runs on batteries, has a timer function and offers 8 flashing modes. Battery power means no cord, which suits a wreath, a pumpkin or a window with no nearby outlet.

It ranks seventh because batteries limit run time and brightness compared with the plug-in strings above. It makes sense only where an outlet is the problem; for general coverage, the weillsnow or DAZZLE BRIGHT are better.

Best for small accents. The caveat is battery life, which the listing does not state, so keep spares for the last week of October.
products.idealFor: Wreaths, pumpkins and spots without an outlet.
products.skipIf: You want to cover a large area.

products.name: TW SHINE Purple and Orange Halloween Lights
products.verdict: End-to-end extendable purple and orange lights with few other details.
products.description:
This TW SHINE set is described as charming purple and orange Halloween lights that are end to end extendable and of high quality. Extendable means you can add a second string without a splitter.

It ranks last because the listing offers no mode count, length or timer, and the high-quality claim is vague. Compared with the other TW SHINE listing above, it has fewer stated features.

A basic add-on strand. The caveat is that, without details, you should confirm length and modes on the product page before ordering.
pros: Easy to add to a set
products.idealFor: Extending an existing display in matching colors.
products.skipIf: You need modes, timer or confirmed length.

methodology.title: Connectability

methodology.description: Low-voltage supplies, UL certification and waterproofing improved scores.

methodology.description: Strings that state their length and specs scored higher than vague listings.

whatMatters.detail: Length tells you how far the string reaches; LED count tells you how dense the glow is. A 500 LED string over 164 feet is sparser than 100 LEDs on 20 feet. Check both on the listing, and measure the rail or tree you plan to wrap before you buy.

End-to-end sets let you plug a second string into the tail of the first, so one outlet powers a longer run. Each product has a limit, such as the DAZZLE BRIGHT's three strings or 1,000 LEDs total. Check the maximum, because exceeding it can blow a fuse.

A memory function remembers your chosen mode when power is cut, and a timer switches the string on and off by itself. Together they stop you resetting lights every night. Brizled and Joomer list both. Check for them on the listing, since cheaper strings often leave them out.

Outdoor Halloween lights face rain, wind and cold. Waterproof ratings and low-voltage supplies like the weillsnow's 29V make a string safer outside. Check the listing for waterproof wording, and keep unrated strings indoors or under cover.

Plug-in strings stay bright and run all night, while battery sets work anywhere but dim and need replacement cells. The LOLStar is battery operated, which suits wreaths and props. Match the power source to the location, and expect to carry spare batteries for the final week.

faq.q: Can I use indoor Halloween lights outside?
faq.a: Only if the listing says waterproof. The weillsnow and TW SHINE state outdoor-friendly weather resistance, while the Joomer and LOLStar do not. Keep unrated strings under a porch roof or inside.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make with string lights?
faq.a: Ignoring the chain limit. The DAZZLE BRIGHT allows up to three strings and under 1,000 LEDs total. Plugging in more than that can overheat the lead or blow a fuse, so count before you connect.

faq.q: Is the weillsnow worth it over the DAZZLE BRIGHT?
faq.a: If you need distance, yes. The weillsnow covers 164 feet with 500 LEDs and runs on 29V, while the DAZZLE BRIGHT gives 300 LEDs per string and lets you connect more strings as your display grows.

faq.q: How do I set up a timer?
faq.a: Use the string's own timer, as on the Brizled, Joomer or LOLStar, or a plug-in outdoor timer. Set the on and off hours before you hang the lights so you are not climbing a ladder to test them.
Wrap each string around a flat piece of cardboard and tape the plug end. Store the weillsnow's 164 feet loosely coiled, since tight kinks can break the thin wire and leave dead sections.
The UL certified 20FT strand states its certification, but incandescent bulbs run hotter than LEDs. Keep them clear of dry foliage and fabric, and never cover a plugged-in string.

finalTake: The weillsnow 500 LED string is the Halloween light to buy for most yards, thanks to its 164 feet of waterproof low-voltage wire and memory function. DAZZLE BRIGHT is the better choice if you want to grow a display over time, and Brizled has the best control set. Pick the LOLStar only where there is no outlet.
